blogs.title: When Leiomyomas Masquerade as Ovarian Masses: Imaging Pitfalls in Pregnancy
blogs.description: A deep dive into the sonographic and MRI features that can lead to misdiagnosis of uterine leiomyomas as adnexal cysts or endometriomas during pregnancy. We’ll discuss how to differentiate these entities, the role of Doppler flow patterns, and practical tips for the obstetric sonographer to avoid unnecessary anxiety and interventions.

blogs.title: Managing Symptomatic Myomas in the Second Trimester: To Operate or Not to Operate?
blogs.description: An evidence‑based review of the decision‑making process for surgical intervention on large or complicated uterine fibroids during mid‑gestation. We’ll weigh the risks of myomectomy (bleeding, miscarriage, preterm labor) against the dangers of mass effect (pain, dyspnea, torsion) and outline a multidisciplinary algorithm for timing, approach, and intra‑operative fetal monitoring.

blogs.title: CA‑125 in Pregnancy: Interpreting a ‘Positive’ Marker Amid Physiologic Peaks
blogs.description: Explores the normal trajectory of CA‑125 throughout gestation, its overlap with benign conditions like leiomyoma and decidualized endometriosis, and how serial measurements can be used (or not) in the work‑up of pelvic masses. The post will also address when tumor markers truly add value versus when they may mislead clinicians.

blogs.title: Anesthetic and Hormonal Strategies to Protect the Fetus During Mid‑Trimester Myomectomy
blogs.description: Focuses on peri‑operative management techniques that were employed in the case—progesterone prophylaxis, fetal heart rate surveillance, choice of antibiotics, and blood product planning. The article will outline best practices for maintaining uteroplacental perfusion and minimizing preterm labor risk during non‑obstetric abdominal surgery.

blogs.title: Delivery Planning After Massive Myomectomy: Cesarean vs. Vaginal Birth
blogs.description: Analyzes how the size, location, and residual myoma burden influence mode of delivery decisions. We’ll review current literature on concurrent cesarean‑myomectomy, uterine scar integrity, and the impact of a large posterior myoma on labor mechanics, offering a decision‑tree for obstetricians facing similar scenarios.

blogs.title: Pregnancy‑Associated Respiratory Compromise from Abdominal Mass Effect: Recognizing and Managing Dyspnea
blogs.description: Highlights the often‑overlooked mechanical respiratory limitation caused by giant intra‑abdominal masses in pregnancy. The post will discuss pathophysiology, clinical assessment, positioning strategies, and criteria for proceeding to surgery to relieve diaphragmatic compression while preserving fetal health.
